# Time Is Scarce Too

<!-- STEP id="day" -->
Every day has 24 hours, for everyone. Sleep, school, travel, homework and meals take most of Meera's day. About 2 free hours are left.

<!-- STEP id="hour" -->
An hour spent playing is an hour not spent reading, helping at home or resting. **Time is a scarce resource, and every use of it has an opportunity cost.**

Your turn: ask your parents about one everyday choice they made. What did they give up?
